true_answer: In ailand, where the ai solar calendar is used, the months and days have adopted the western standard, although the years are still based on the traditional Buddhist calendar. A ﬁscal calendar generally means the accounting year of a government or a business. It is used for budgeting, keeping accounts, and taxation. It is a set of 12 months that may start at any date in a year. e US government's ﬁscal year starts on 1 October and ends on 30 September. e government of India's ﬁscal year starts on 1 April and ends on 31 March.
